import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths as given
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_7.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/training_8.csv",
]

# Read all source CSV files into a list of DataFrames
# Use index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column as per hint 24
dfs = []
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# All source tables have the exact same schema as the target:
# ['created_at', 'text', 'coordinates', 'hashtags']
# So we can concatenate (union) all source DataFrames vertically

# Concatenate all source DataFrames
combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure columns are exactly in the target schema order
target_columns = ['created_at', 'text', 'coordinates', 'hashtags']
combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

# Convert all columns to string type as target schema requires strings
# For 'hashtags' and 'coordinates', which may be lists/dicts or NaN, convert to string representation
combined_df['created_at'] = combined_df['created_at'].astype(str)
combined_df['text'] = combined_df['text'].astype(str)

# For 'coordinates' and 'hashtags', convert NaN to string 'NaN' and others to string
combined_df['coordinates'] = combined_df['coordinates'].apply(lambda x: str(x) if pd.notna(x) else 'NaN')
combined_df['hashtags'] = combined_df['hashtags'].apply(lambda x: str(x) if pd.notna(x) else 'NaN')

# Write the combined DataFrame to the target CSV file path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_16/target_multisource_cot.csv"
combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
